jamie (product): Customer asks: let reserved pools temporarily shrink for maintenance windows (15% for 2 hours, up to 3x/week) in return for a small credit. Can we support this as a feature?

ravi (eng-platform): Two options: 1) opportunistic fill (others use capacity) + guaranteed reclaim; 2) parked but not reusable. Opportunistic keeps utilization but needs preemption guarantees.

tess (eng-sre): Reclaim guarantees are tough. We need deterministic eviction, region caps, and a circuit breaker if reclaims fail. Instrument reclaim_latency_p95 and reclaim_fail_rate.

maria (sales): This would help close some deals. Need contract template: max reduction, reclaim SLA, and test/acceptance.

kevin (finance): Model impact: credit vs increased utilization. I'll run a simple scenario and post numbers in RFC.

ravi (eng-platform): Implementation sketch: add a schedule object on reservation and a reclaim handshake. Provide dry-run/sim endpoint for demos. Rough effort: prototype 1 sprint, core 2-3 sprints, billing/UI 1 sprint.

jamie (product): Launch checklist idea: canary reclaim success >=99%, reclaim p95 <30s, co-tenant tail-latency <5%, billing validated, support playbook. Owners: Ravi RFC, Tess runbook, Maria contract, Kevin finance. Timeline by next roadmap sync?

bot-deploy: RFC created: https://rfc.internal/temp-pool-shrink (draft)
